prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night on a wide black river, the camera low at the waterline: in the middle distance a small wooden rowing boat is sinking, water up to the gunwales, and in it a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat with a heavy gold mayoral chain round his neck, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache, frantic, bails water out with a tin bucket that is full of soggy blank green paper money with no printing, notes spilling and floating all round the boat. Behind him the lit skyline of a 1930s city, its warm windows and a small red moon reflected in long streaks on the black water. Most of the frame in deep shadow; the brightest values are the city lights on the water and the floating notes. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
